quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with handicap permits or tags. It is posted in parking lots and tells drivers where they can and cannot park.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Slow down and enter at a low speed. Yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is flowing in both directions ahead.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane leads off the highway. You can change lanes to stay on the highway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing the road. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you of construction zones. This sign tells you that road work is starting ahead. Be careful around construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the clearance above the road is low.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mark school areas. This sign shows a school crossing ahead. Watch for children and obey any crossing guard signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be prepared for two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. Reduce your speed to 35 mph for safety.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This five-sided sign warns you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane will end. Drivers in that lane must move left safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can turn from certain lanes only.
Drivers in both lanes must merge carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. The left lane is only for buses and cars with a driver and one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming and you should be ready to stop or slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic light at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is very low.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is very low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not go under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is joining from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is joining from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will be joining from the right side.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions or dangers ahead.
It helps you find cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road work ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions or dangers ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols and tell you about dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming and you should prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Keep your speed at 50 miles per hour for the next 50 miles.
Police will enforce speed limits for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest safe speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A person directing traffic is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to not block the intersection. It is posted near intersections where drivers must be careful not to stop in the roadway.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid getting a ticket.
The highest safe speed when conditions are normal.
The highest safe speed in all weather and road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest safe speed when conditions are normal.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are bad. Always slow down when weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road changes ahead and turns to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The road curves to the right ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves to the right ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road will curve to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign means there is an island, median, or barrier ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if cars are coming.
Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection. You may not need to stop.
Stop only if there is traffic on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must stop completely. Wait until it is safe, then go. Let other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Pedestrians cannot cross at this location.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. This sign tells you the right lane will be closed due to construction. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. If you are following this driver, be ready to stop too.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you to follow a different route because the road ahead is under construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.
The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road ahead has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead is covered with loose gravel. Drive slowly and carefully because loose gravel reduces your tire's grip on the road.

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling that they plan to turn right. If you are following this driver, be ready to adjust your path.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safe speed limit in a residential area.
The safe speed for exiting an expressway.
The safe speed for entering an expressway.
The safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safe speed for exiting an expressway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the recommended safe speed for an expressway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you to stay on the right side of the road to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. A flagger is a construction worker who directs traffic. Follow their signals carefully.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the road will become a divided highway soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at this exact speed.
The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
Drive through intersections at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you must drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Left lane drivers must turn left.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that from this lane you may either turn right or drive straight ahead at the intersection.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it for passing other cars or going straight through traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you to watch for dangers and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in work zones.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones ahead. This sign tells you that penalties are stricter in work zones to protect workers and drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows a rule you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the roadway ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a playground is nearby and you should watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or about to enter a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a side road is ahead and traffic may enter from it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill slope is coming.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that parking in this area is not allowed. Your vehicle will be towed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign means the road may be slippery when it is wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign shows a right turn is not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means you should:

options.text: Follow a detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow a detour to the right, but only if it's convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow a detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black lettering. Detour signs show you an alternate route around blocked roads. Always follow the detour.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided into separate lanes. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about work zones. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions carefully.

questions.question: This green arrow on a lane use control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means that lane is open and you can use it.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this example).

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a change in traffic flow because of construction work ahead. Follow the detour signs to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a merge is ahead. Two lanes of traffic going the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield for left turn on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield for left turn on green.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you must yield to oncoming traffic when turning left at a green light. Turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that buggies may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. The signal shows when it is safe to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you to look for people crossing the street. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that traffic from the right is joining your lane. Be ready to slow down and let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering a one-way street or expressway ramp from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering a one-way street or expressway ramp from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic on this road goes only one way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and give the right-of-way to others.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you approach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians go first if they are there.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you should:

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the lower speed zone.
Not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed now. The new, lower speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a school is near. Slow down and watch for children crossing the street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet. Drive carefully.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes, if safe, to let traffic merge.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering the freeway. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns that the shoulder of the road is lower than the paved surface.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median or divider between them. You must drive on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead. Be ready to stop for children.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road is ahead. An intersection means another road crosses this one.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you drive forward.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only to turn left. Do not use this lane for regular driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop if needed. Let vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that lanes are shifting ahead. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign appears at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mark railroad crossings. This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming up and you should watch for trains.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other traffic pass first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a new lane is being added ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction areas. This sign tells you that road construction ahead will change your normal route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that bicycles cross or ride in this area. Drive carefully and watch for bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to a nearby fire station. Watch for emergency vehicles that may be entering the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means you must stop. Give the right-of-way to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street. It is a regulation sign that you must obey.

questions.question: What is the biggest concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.
You may damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and give the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming ahead.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On a horizontal light, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.
